root-text:
Pszczoly — Modded Gameplay Guide

Kuboczoch’s index of the gameplay systems in Pszczoly 1.0 for Vintage Story 1.22.7. Choose a topic, then a mod. Each detail page recommends a starting point and retains all its active native guides. Mod DB links open external documentation; they are separate links, not automatic redirects.

• Food & Cooking
• Crafting & Workshops
• Gear & Tools
• Farming & Husbandry
• Movement & Transport
• Combat & Survival
• Economy & Community

Good first stops
Toolsmith: multipart tools
Immersive Woodworking: in-world processing
Food systems and their companion modules

Ordinary item, block and recipe pages remain in the native handbook. This index does not reproduce upstream manuals. Settings and server overrides may change mechanics.
category-food-cooking-text:
Back to Pszczoly guide

Food & Cooking

• A Culinary Artillery — Cooking equipment and processing: mixing bowls, kneading, simmering pans and cauldrons, tree spiles, bottles and stoppers, eggs, meat hooks and… [Native guides]

• Core of Arts — Despite its core name, installed content exposes player-facing in-world liquid/solid mixing and dough-forming systems [Native guides]

• DairyPlus — Separate cream, churn butter and stretch mozzarella using cream separator, churns, cheese vats and liquid thermometer. [Native guides]

• Expanded Foods: Chef's Tricks — Expanded Foods module adds salt/resin and egg processing, crushed washed eggshells, food preservation helpers and breadcrumb animal feed [Native guides]

• Expanded Foods: Core — Expanded food preparation and recipes: chopping, drying, aging, soy products, fermented sauces, broth, oils, syrup, pasta, sausages, sushi, breads… [Native guides]

• Expanded Foods: Meals — Expanded Foods meals module adds rice, salads, noodles, pies, pasta and varied meal recipes [Native guides]

• FoodShelves — Specialized food storage with freshness, drying and curing modifiers and ice-cooled cabinets/freezers. [Native guides]

• kevinsfurniture — Functional furniture including a four-burner stove, storage, beds and a Galileo thermometer. [Mod DB]

• Manual Dough — Knead flour into dough against a water source/container instead of relying on the grid recipe. [Mod DB]

• Rustic Cookery — Hands-on cooking and preservation using roasting dishes, meat slabs, smoke racks/hooks, pot roasts and braised dishes. [Mod DB]

• Simple Tea — Brew flowers and herbs into teas with temperature-dependent strength and timed beneficial effects. [Native guides]

• Stick Roast — Use a roasting stick and a holder over a fire to cook and eat skewered food. [Mod DB]

• Stone Bake Oven — Construct and operate a modular stone baking oven using baking-space, heat-distribution and heat-source components. [Native guides]

• Tankards, Goblets and More! — Craft functional drinking and liquid-storage vessels such as tankards, goblets, bottles and demijohns, alongside alcohol-soaked bandages. [Mod DB]
category-crafting-workshops-text:
Back to Pszczoly guide

Crafting & Workshops

• Bricklayers — Colored clay, porcelain, glazing and glass production, pigments and frit, durable kiln, hot glass workshop and industrial glassmaking chains [Native guides]

• Dressmakers — Craft and trade vanilla common, class-specific and Nadiyan clothing through added recipes [Mod DB]

• Expanded Matter — Expanded materials and chemical industry: ores/minerals, acids, bitumen, coke, sulfur processing, starch, binders, herbarium and ink/paper chains… [Mod DB]

• Falling Tree — Physical tree felling with directional falls and impact damage [Mod DB]

• Immersive Mining — Impact-by-impact mining and chopping with tool damage, reach penalties, durability and stamina costs. [Mod DB]

• ImmersiveOreCrush — Crush ore chunks on the ground by hitting them with a tool. [Mod DB]

• ImmersiveWoodworking — In-world woodworking with chopping blocks, paired sawhorses, pitsaws, powered sawmills/choppers and bark/tar processing. [Native guides]

• Manual Shingle — Hand-knead clay into raw shingles or bowls using held clay. [Mod DB]

• Millwright — Reinforced rotors, improved sails, vertical-axis windmills, reinforced brakes and room-preserving axle passthroughs. [Mod DB]

• Pewter — Alloy tin, lead and copper into pewter, cast tableware parts and assemble usable bowls, six-serving crocks and five-litre jugs. [Mod DB]

• Pewter Additions: Gold and Silver — Gold and silver versions of Pewter tableware made through its casting/assembly chain. [Mod DB]

• Tailor's Delight — Tailoring production using spindles, stitching awls, prepared leather bundles, twine, buttons and other clothing components, including functional… [Mod DB]

• Toolsmith — Build multipart tools with interchangeable heads, handles and bindings [Native guides]
category-gear-tools-text:
Back to Pszczoly guide

Gear & Tools

• Adventurer's Walking Stick — Craftable walking sticks with walking-speed and hunger-rate benefits, plus survivalist knife, lantern, shepherd, sling and spearstaff variants. [Native guides]

• chiseltools — Craftable hand planers, wedges, pantographs and building tools [Native guides]

• Quivers And Sheaths — Wearable belts, quivers, sheaths, slings, holsters and pouches with specialized ammunition/tool slots and quick draw/return controls. [Mod DB]

• Scaffolding — Craftable climbable scaffolding for building work, with structural support/stability and configurable climbing movement. [Mod DB]

• Spyglass — Craft a metal-and-glass spyglass for distant observation with adjustable magnification. [Mod DB]

• Stone Harvesting — Harvest intact rock using hammer-and-chisel work on the connections around a rock face. [Mod DB]
category-farming-husbandry-text:
Back to Pszczoly guide

Farming & Husbandry

• Art of Growing — Reworked crop stages, grain bundles dried then threshed with a stick, flax retting/washing/softening/combing, grass mowing and layered haystacks. [Mod DB]

• betterhusbandry — Animal generation/trust progression through feeding, body condition, petting and milking, with neglect penalties. [Mod DB]

• Catch Livestock — Carry tamed livestock of generation greater than zero by Ctrl-right-click without basket traps [Mod DB]

• Equus: Medieval Horses — Domestic medieval horse breeds with mounted travel, tack and breeding/husbandry integration. [Mod DB]

• Equus: Wild Horses 2.0 — Wild horse species, domestication and riding: saddles, bridles, lead ropes, saddlebags and tack provide transport and livestock systems. [Mod DB]

• From Golden Combs — Advanced apiculture with ceramic and Langstroth hives, frames, honey/wax harvesting and crop pollination. [Native guides]

• Livestock Welfare — Animal welfare with thirst, weather shelter, cleanliness, illness, bedding, breeding and young-animal care. [Native guides]

• Manual Harvesting — Pick individual visible fruit from fruit-tree foliage and branches. [Mod DB]

• Natural Fertilizer — Collect animal droppings, compost manure with grass/rot and apply the resulting fertilizer. [Mod DB]

• Wool & More — Shear domesticated animals, wash fleece into fibers, make wool twine/cloth, mordant and dye it, and knit clothing or craft carrying/storage… [Native guides]
category-movement-transport-text:
Back to Pszczoly guide

Movement & Transport

• Algernons Watersheds — Watershed terrain, river valleys, navigable water and hydrology change exploration, settlement and transport planning. [Mod DB]

• Carry On — Lift and carry placed storage containers, including carrying one on the back [Mod DB]

• Cartwrights Caravan — Seraph-pulled or pushed carts, sleds and market stalls with storage and canopy options [Mod DB]

• Catch Ledge — Grab and hang from ledges, climb up, traverse corners and leap between holds [Mod DB]

• ChargedJump — Charge sneaking or sprinting jumps for greater height or distance [Mod DB]

• Climb Mountain — Climb stone/ore mountain walls, traverse, slide, arrest falling momentum and combine with ledge catches. [Mod DB]

• Containers Bundle — Wicker, wood, linen, metal and stone storage containers [Mod DB]

• Crawl&Dive — Crawl through one-block gaps [Mod DB]

• K's Cartography Table — Crafted cartography table for sharing map exploration and waypoints with other players. [Native guides]

• Natural Trail Mod Maro Update — Traffic from players and animals develops natural trails, paths and roads [Native guides]

• PurposefulStorage — Craftable specialized storage for equipment and resources, including apothecary cabinets that prevent alcohol-bandage drying and pelt racks that… [Mod DB]

• Rivers — Generated river networks with currents that affect swimmers [Mod DB]

• Rough Seas — Nautical survival and boatbuilding: construct and maintain vessels, navigate weather, repair hulls, bail flooding, and use ropes and anchors [Native guides]

• Sprint Momentum — Movement has acceleration, deceleration and turning inertia instead of instant speed changes, with surface-dependent tuning affecting players and… [Mod DB]

• ToolBelt — Wear the sturdy belt for two accessible tool slots or the heavy tool belt for four, according to this pack’s bundled Toolbelt configuration. [Mod DB]

• Vault And Roll — Vault obstacles and perform timed landing rolls that can mitigate fall damage. [Mod DB]
category-combat-survival-text:
Back to Pszczoly guide

Combat & Survival

• BloodTrail — Wounded animals bleed into trackable trails for hunting and locating fleeing prey. [Mod DB]

• Butchering — Transport carcasses, skin on hooks and process on butchery tables using knives and cleavers [Native guides]

• Combat Overhaul — Combat overhaul with stance/weapon-handling, parrying, blocking, attacks, damage/resistance and shield behavior [Mod DB]

• Combat Overhaul : Armory — Functional layered armor sets, helmets, shields, pauldrons, greaves and protective clothing for Combat Overhaul [Mod DB]

• Downed — Survivable downed state with bleeding-out/passing-out decisions, revival, execution, dragging and carrying casualties on the back [Mod DB]

• FireStarters — Environmental fire starting: alternative ignition methods and weather, wind and exposure restrictions. [Native guides]

• Manual Firestarter — Manually light ground tinder and carry it to ignite a firepit or other target. [Mod DB]

• Real Smoke — Combustion produces temperature-dependent smoke [Native guides]

• SeasonedFirewood — Prepare and cure firewood into seasoned and aged fuel, changing ignition suitability, temperature and burn duration. [Mod DB]

• SlowTox — Alcohol is absorbed and cleared over time, builds tolerance, and can grant regeneration/combat benefits or cause movement penalties and… [Mod DB]

• Temporal Symphony — Temporal-storm overhaul with stronger bell enemies, bellhead shivers that summon hostile creatures, and reworked rift-weather spawn patterns,… [Mod DB]
category-economy-community-text:
Back to Pszczoly guide

Economy & Community

• BetterTraders — Merchant structures include furnished shops/workspaces and ordinary, rich and poor merchant variants [Mod DB]

• Coinage — Design a coin punch and use metal plates to make planchets [Native guides]

• Coins — Player-issued banknote currencies with mint blocks, denominations, change recipes, wallets, shared minting permissions and Vinconomy shop integration. [Native guides]

• Notice Board — Crafted communal notice boards supporting notices, signed parchment and attached map locations. [Mod DB]

• Tabletop Games — Craft and play with boards, customizable pieces, playing cards and shufflers [Native guides]

• Vinconomy — Build player-run shops and purchase stalls, use registers and catalogs, and trade stock through a configured currency economy. [Mod DB]
